_comment: Source of truth for the app identity, in the shape Bubblewrap's
`npx @bubblewrap/cli` reads and writes. Everything in here is mirrored by
hand into the Gradle/manifest/resource files next to it, because this
repository builds the TWA without running the CLI (no Node, and the CLI
would overwrite the hand-written comments). If you change a value here,
change the Gradle/manifest copy too -- nothing reads this file at build
time. See ../../twa/README.md for the two-field checklist.
